ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: ذُوقُوا فِتْنَتَكُمْ: taste your severe torment and the fruits of your corruption.

metadata.theme: The Reckoning Realized: Experiencing the Desired Punishment
metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: ذُوقُوا فِتْنَتَكُمْ: taste your severe torment and the fruits of your corruption.

english_translations.sahih_international: [And will be told], "Taste your torment. This is that for which you were impatient."
english_translations.pickthall: (And it will be said unto them): Taste your torment (which ye inflicted). This is what ye sought to hasten.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: "Taste ye your trial! This is what ye used to ask to be hastened!"
english_translations.shakir: Taste your persecution! this is what you would hasten on.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: and will be told, "Suffer the torment which you wanted to experience immediately".
english_translations.mohsin_khan: "Taste you your trial (burning)! This is what you used to ask to be hastened!"
english_translations.arberry: 'Taste your trial! This is that you were seeking to hasten.'

ayahs.transliteration: inna l-mutaqīna fī jannātin waʿuyūnin
ayahs.translation_bn: মুত্তাকীরা থাকবে জান্নাত আর ঝর্ণাধারার মাঝে।
ayahs.translation_en: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs,
ayahs.conventional_en: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs,
ayahs.conventional_bn: মুত্তাকীরা থাকবে জান্নাত আর ঝর্ণাধারার মাঝে।
ayahs.meta_bn: The Flourishing Biosphere: মুত্তাকীদের জান্নাত ও প্রস্রবণের নিবাস
ayahs.meta_en: The Flourishing Biosphere: Paradise for the Conscious
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ: indeed the righteous reside in fertile groves and flowing aquifers.

metadata.theme: The Flourishing Biosphere: Paradise for the Conscious
metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ: indeed the righteous reside in fertile groves and flowing aquifers.

english_translations.sahih_international: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs,
english_translations.pickthall: Lo! those who keep from evil will dwell amid gardens and watersprings,
english_translations.yusuf_ali: As to the Righteous, they will be in the midst of Gardens and Springs,
english_translations.shakir: Surely those who guard (against evil) shall be in gardens and fountains.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: The pious ones will live amidst gardens and springs,
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Verily, the Muttaqun (pious - see V. 2:2) will be in the midst of Gardens and Springs (in the Paradise),
english_translations.arberry: Surely the godfearing shall be among gardens and fountains

ayahs.transliteration: ākhidhīna mā ātāhum rabbuhum innahum kānū qabla dhālika muḥ'sinīna
ayahs.translation_bn: তাদের প্রতিপালক যা তাদেরকে দিবেন তা তারা ভোগ করবে, কারণ তারা পূর্বে (দুনিয়ার জীবনে) ছিল সৎকর্মশীল,
ayahs.translation_en: Accepting what their Lord has given them. Indeed, they were before that doers of good.
ayahs.conventional_en: Accepting what their Lord has given them. Indeed, they were before that doers of good.
ayahs.conventional_bn: তাদের প্রতিপালক যা তাদেরকে দিবেন তা তারা ভোগ করবে, কারণ তারা পূর্বে (দুনিয়ার জীবনে) ছিল সৎকর্মশীল,
ayahs.meta_bn: Receptive Fulfillment: পার্থিব জীবনের সৎকর্মের বিনিময়ে ঐশ্বরিক প্রতিদান
ayahs.meta_en: Receptive Fulfillment: Gratefully Receiving Divine Sustenance
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: مُحْسِنِينَ: systemic benefactors who optimized their conduct and refined societal harmony.

metadata.theme: Receptive Fulfillment: Gratefully Receiving Divine Sustenance
metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: مُحْسِنِينَ: systemic benefactors who optimized their conduct and refined societal harmony.

english_translations.sahih_international: Accepting what their Lord has given them. Indeed, they were before that doers of good.
english_translations.pickthall: Taking that which their Lord giveth them; for lo! aforetime they were doers of good;
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Taking joy in the things which their Lord gives them, because, before then, they lived a good life.
english_translations.shakir: Taking what their Lord gives them; surely they were before that, the doers of good.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: receiving their reward from their Lord. They had been righteous people before the Day of Judgment.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Taking joy in the things which their Lord has given them. Verily, they were before this Muhsinun (good-doers - see V. 2:112).
english_translations.arberry: taking whatsoever their Lord has given them; they were good-doers before that.

ayahs.transliteration: kānū qalīlan mina al-layli mā yahjaʿūna
ayahs.translation_bn: তারা রাত্রিকালে খুব কমই শয়ন করত।
ayahs.translation_en: They used to sleep but little of the night,
ayahs.conventional_en: They used to sleep but little of the night,
ayahs.conventional_bn: তারা রাত্রিকালে খুব কমই শয়ন করত।
ayahs.meta_bn: Nocturnal Devotion: রাতের সামান্য ভাগে নিদ্রা ও গভীর সাধনা
ayahs.meta_en: Nocturnal Devotion: Vigilance During the Night Hours
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: كَانُوا قَلِيلًا مِّنَ اللَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ: they used to sleep only for a small part of the nocturnal cycle.

metadata.theme: Nocturnal Devotion: Vigilance During the Night Hours
metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: كَانُوا قَلِيلًا مِّنَ اللَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ: they used to sleep only for a small part of the nocturnal cycle.

english_translations.sahih_international: They used to sleep but little of the night,
english_translations.pickthall: They used to sleep but little of the night,
english_translations.yusuf_ali: They were in the habit of sleeping but little by night,
english_translations.shakir: They used to sleep but little in the night.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: They slept very little during the night
english_translations.mohsin_khan: They used to sleep but little by night [invoking their Lord (Allah) and praying, with fear and hope].
english_translations.arberry: Little of the night would they slumber,

ayahs.transliteration: wabil-asḥāri hum yastaghfirūna
ayahs.translation_bn: আর তারা রাত্রির শেষ প্রহরে ক্ষমা প্রার্থনা করত।

words.translation_en: And in the hours before dawn

ayahs.translation_en: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness,
ayahs.conventional_en: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness,
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর তারা রাত্রির শেষ প্রহরে ক্ষমা প্রার্থনা করত।
ayahs.meta_bn: Pre-Dawn Rectification: শেষ রাতের প্রশান্ত প্রহরে ক্ষমা প্রার্থনা
ayahs.meta_en: Pre-Dawn Rectification: Seeking Forgiveness in the Pre-Dawn Hours
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: وَبِالْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ: and in the pre-dawn twilights they constantly petition for systemic cleansing and forgiveness.

metadata.theme: Pre-Dawn Rectification: Seeking Forgiveness in the Pre-Dawn Hours
metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: وَبِالْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ: and in the pre-dawn twilights they constantly petition for systemic cleansing and forgiveness.

english_translations.sahih_international: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness,
english_translations.pickthall: And ere the dawning of each day would seek forgiveness,
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And in the hour of early dawn, they (were found) praying for Forgiveness;
english_translations.shakir: And in the morning they asked forgiveness.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: and asked for forgiveness in the early morning.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And in the hours before dawn, they were (found) asking (Allah) for forgiveness,
english_translations.arberry: and in the mornings they would ask for forgiveness;

ayahs.transliteration: wafī amwālihim ḥaqqun lilssāili wal-maḥrūmi
ayahs.translation_bn: এবং তাদের ধন-মালে আছে যাঞ্ঝাকারী ও বঞ্চিতদের অধিকার (যা তারা আদায় করত)।
ayahs.translation_en: And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived.
ayahs.conventional_en: And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived.
ayahs.conventional_bn: এবং তাদের ধন-মালে আছে যাঞ্ঝাকারী ও বঞ্চিতদের অধিকার (যা তারা আদায় করত)।
ayahs.meta_bn: Economic Equity: সম্পদে বঞ্চিত ও সাহায্যপ্রার্থীদের নির্ধারিত অধিকার
ayahs.meta_en: Economic Equity: Institutional Rights of the Needy and Deprived
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: حَقٌّ لِّلسَّائِلِ وَالْمَحْرُومِ: an established right of restitution for the petitioner and the economically marginalized.

metadata.theme: Economic Equity: Institutional Rights of the Needy and Deprived
metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: حَقٌّ لِّلسَّائِلِ وَالْمَحْرُومِ: an established right of restitution for the petitioner and the economically marginalized.

english_translations.sahih_international: And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived.
english_translations.pickthall: And in their wealth the beggar and the outcast had due share.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And in their wealth and possessions (was remembered) the right of the (needy,) him who asked, and him who (for some reason) was prevented (from asking).
english_translations.shakir: And in their property was a portion due to him who begs and to him who is denied (good).
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: They assigned a share of their property for the needy and the destitute.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And in their properties there was the right of the beggar, and the Mahrum (the poor who does not ask the others).
english_translations.arberry: and the beggar and the outcast had a share in their wealth.

ayahs.transliteration: wafī l-arḍi āyātun lil'mūqinīna
ayahs.translation_bn: নিশ্চিত বিশ্বাসীদের জন্য পৃথিবীতে আছে নিদর্শন,
ayahs.translation_en: And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith]
ayahs.conventional_en: And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith]
ayahs.conventional_bn: নিশ্চিত বিশ্বাসীদের জন্য পৃথিবীতে আছে নিদর্শন,
ayahs.meta_bn: Terrestrial Evidence: পৃথিবীতে দৃঢ় প্রত্যয়ীদের জন্য প্রাকৃতিক প্রমাণ
ayahs.meta_en: Terrestrial Evidence: Signs Across the Earth for Firm Believers
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: وَفِي الْأَرْضِ آيَاتٌ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ: throughout the terrestrial planet are empirical proof-vectors for observers of verified knowledge.

metadata.theme: Terrestrial Evidence: Signs Across the Earth for Firm Believers
metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: وَفِي الْأَرْضِ آيَاتٌ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ: throughout the terrestrial planet are empirical proof-vectors for observers of verified knowledge.

english_translations.sahih_international: And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith]
english_translations.pickthall: And in the earth are portents for those whose faith is sure.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: On the earth are signs for those of assured Faith,
english_translations.shakir: And in the earth there are signs for those who are sure,
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: In the earth there is evidence (of the Truth) for those who have strong faith.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And on the earth are signs for those who have Faith with certainty,
english_translations.arberry: In the earth are signs for those having sure faith;

ayahs.transliteration: wafī anfusikum afalā tub'ṣirūna
ayahs.translation_bn: আর (নিদর্শন আছে) তোমাদের মাঝেও, তোমরা কি দেখ না?
ayahs.translation_en: And in yourselves. Then will you not see?
ayahs.conventional_en: And in yourselves. Then will you not see?
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর (নিদর্শন আছে) তোমাদের মাঝেও, তোমরা কি দেখ না?
ayahs.meta_bn: Intra-Somatic Architecture: মানবদেহের জৈবিক ও মানসিক নিদর্শনের পর্যবেক্ষণ
ayahs.meta_en: Intra-Somatic Architecture: Observing the Human Structural Design
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: وَفِي أَنفُسِكُمْ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ: and within your cellular, neurological, and physical architecture; will you not observe?

metadata.theme: Intra-Somatic Architecture: Observing the Human Structural Design
metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: وَفِي أَنفُسِكُمْ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ: and within your cellular, neurological, and physical architecture; will you not observe?

english_translations.sahih_international: And in yourselves. Then will you not see?
english_translations.pickthall: And (also) in yourselves. Can ye then not see?
english_translations.yusuf_ali: As also in your own selves: Will ye not then see?
english_translations.shakir: And in your own souls (too); will you not then see?
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: There is also evidence of the Truth within your own selves. Will you then not see?
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And also in your ownselves. Will you not then see?
english_translations.arberry: and in your selves; what, do you not see?

ayahs.transliteration: wafī l-samāi riz'qukum wamā tūʿadūna
ayahs.translation_bn: এবং আকাশে আছে তোমাদের রিযক আর আছে যার ও‘য়াদা তোমাদেরকে দেয়া হয়েছে।
ayahs.translation_en: And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised.
ayahs.conventional_en: And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised.
ayahs.conventional_bn: এবং আকাশে আছে তোমাদের রিযক আর আছে যার ও‘য়াদা তোমাদেরকে দেয়া হয়েছে।
ayahs.meta_bn: Cosmic Sustenance: মহাকাশ ও বায়ুমণ্ডলে শক্তির প্রবাহ ও প্রতিশ্রুত রিজিক
ayahs.meta_en: Cosmic Sustenance: Atmospheric and Solar Engines of Provision
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: وَفِي السَّمَاءِ رِزْقُكُمْ: and in the celestial atmospheric realm lies the matrix of your solar and hydrological provision.

metadata.theme: Cosmic Sustenance: Atmospheric and Solar Engines of Provision
metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: وَفِي السَّمَاءِ رِزْقُكُمْ: and in the celestial atmospheric realm lies the matrix of your solar and hydrological provision.

english_translations.sahih_international: And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised.
english_translations.pickthall: And in the heaven is your providence and that which ye are promised;
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And in heaven is your Sustenance, as (also) that which ye are promised.
english_translations.shakir: And in the heaven is your sustenance and what you are threatened with.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: In the heavens there is your sustenance and that which you were promised (Paradise).
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And in the heaven is your provision, and that which you are promised.
english_translations.arberry: And in heaven is your provision, and that you are promised.

ayahs.transliteration: fawarabbi l-samāi wal-arḍi innahu laḥaqqun mith'la mā annakum tanṭiqūna
ayahs.translation_bn: আকাশ ও যমীনের প্রতিপালকের শপথ! এ সব অবশ্যই সত্য, এমনই দৃঢ় সত্য যেমন তোমরা (যে কথাবার্তা) বলে থাক (সেই কথাবার্তা বলার ব্যাপারটা যেমন নিঃসন্দেহে সত্য)।
ayahs.translation_en: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking.
ayahs.conventional_en: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আকাশ ও যমীনের প্রতিপালকের শপথ! এ সব অবশ্যই সত্য, এমনই দৃঢ় সত্য যেমন তোমরা (যে কথাবার্তা) বলে থাক (সেই কথাবার্তা বলার ব্যাপারটা যেমন নিঃসন্দেহে সত্য)।
ayahs.meta_bn: Axiomatic Certainty: নভোমণ্ডল ও ভূমণ্ডলের রবের নামে সত্যের অকাট্যতার শপথ
ayahs.meta_en: Axiomatic Certainty: Incontestable Reality of Speech and Revelation
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: إِنَّهُ لَحَقٌّ مِّثْلَ مَا أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ: it is an axiomatic reality, as undeniable as your sensory capacity to speak and communicate.

metadata.theme: Axiomatic Certainty: Incontestable Reality of Speech and Revelation
metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: إِنَّهُ لَحَقٌّ مِّثْلَ مَا أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ: it is an axiomatic reality, as undeniable as your sensory capacity to speak and communicate.

english_translations.sahih_international: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking.
english_translations.pickthall: And by the Lord of the heavens and the earth, it is the truth, even as (it is true) that ye speak.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Then, by the Lord of heaven and earth, this is the very Truth, as much as the fact that ye can speak intelligently to each other.
english_translations.shakir: And by the Lord of the heavens and the earth! it is most surely the truth, just as you do speak.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: This, by the Lord of the heavens and the earth is as certain as your ability to speak.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Then, by the Lord of the heaven and the earth, it is the truth (i.e. what has been promised to you), just as it is the truth that you can speak.
english_translations.arberry: So by the Lord of heaven and earth, it is as surely true as that you have speech.

ayahs.transliteration: hal atāka ḥadīthu ḍayfi ib'rāhīma l-muk'ramīna
ayahs.translation_bn: তোমার কাছে ইবরাহীমের সম্মানিত মেহমানদের খবর পৌঁছেছে কি?
ayahs.translation_en: Has there reached you the story of the honored guests of Abraham? -
ayahs.conventional_en: Has there reached you the story of the honored guests of Abraham? -
ayahs.conventional_bn: তোমার কাছে ইবরাহীমের সম্মানিত মেহমানদের খবর পৌঁছেছে কি?
ayahs.meta_bn: Honored Cosmic Emissaries: ইবরাহীমের নিকট সম্মানিত ফেরেশতাদের আগমন
ayahs.meta_en: Honored Cosmic Emissaries: The Account of Abraham's Celestial Guests
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: ضَيْفِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْمُكْرَمِينَ: the honored celestial emissaries visiting Abraham in human form.

metadata.theme: Honored Cosmic Emissaries: The Account of Abraham's Celestial Guests
metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: ضَيْفِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْمُكْرَمِينَ: the honored celestial emissaries visiting Abraham in human form.

english_translations.sahih_international: Has there reached you the story of the honored guests of Abraham? -
english_translations.pickthall: Hath the story of Abraham's honoured guests reached thee (O Muhammad)?
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Has the story reached thee, of the honoured guests of Abraham?
english_translations.shakir: Has there come to you information about the honored guests of Ibrahim?
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Have you heard the story of the honorable guests of Abraham?
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Has the story reached you, of the honoured guests [three angels; Jibrael (Gabriel) along with another two] of Ibrahim (Abraham)?

ayahs.translation_en: I do not want from them any provision, nor do I want them to feed Me.

ayahs.translation_bn: কাজেই যারা যুলম করেছে তাদের প্রাপ্য তাই যে প্রাপ্য পূর্বে ছিল তাদের মত লোকেদের; কাজেই (নিজেদের প্রাপ্য পাওয়ার জন্য) তারা যেন তাড়াহুড়া না করে।
ayahs.translation_en: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their predecessors, so let them not impatiently urge Me.
ayahs.conventional_en: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their predecessors, so let them not impatiently urge Me.

english_translations.sahih_international: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their predecessors, so let them not impatiently urge Me.
english_translations.pickthall: And lo! for those who (now) do wrong there is an evil day like unto the evil day (which came for) their likes (of old); so let them not ask Me to hasten on (that day).
english_translations.yusuf_ali: For the Wrong-doers, their portion is like unto the portion of their fellows (of earlier generations): then let them not ask Me to hasten (that portion)!
english_translations.shakir: So surely those who are unjust shall have a portion like the portion of their companions, therefore let them not ask Me to hasten on.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: The unjust will bear a burden like that of their unjust predecessors. Let them not make Me bring immediate punishment upon them.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is a portion of torment like to the evil portion of torment (which came for) their likes (of old), so let them not ask Me to hasten on!
english_translations.arberry: The evildoers shall have their portion, like the portion of their fellows; so let them not hasten Me!

ayahs.translation_en: And woe to those who have disbelieved from their Day which they are promised.
ayahs.conventional_en: And woe to those who have disbelieved from their Day which they are promised.
